title: Gaps

gaps.what remains unknown: No validated light/heavy/reward phase-duration table transfers across genres, cameras and input cadences.
gaps.how to test: Compare timing variants while holding asset art and sound fixed. Measure contact identification, response performance, perceived weight, preference and fatigue. Store display fps, capture fps, game timebase and actual ms.

gaps.what remains unknown: Riot’s importance scale does not publish a universal mapping to size, luminance, duration or layer count.
gaps.how to test: Establish ranked simultaneous-cue tasks; vary one prominence channel at a time; test whether participants identify the most consequential event correctly.

gaps.what remains unknown: Named examples and models are not safe default amplitudes, frequencies or durations for Roblox.
gaps.how to test: Test device/camera-specific variants with optional controls; measure aim/navigation errors, comfort and hit identification alongside perceived impact. Keep gameplay freeze distinct from animation-only hold.

gaps.what remains unknown: A legal or technical threshold is not an artistic target or guarantee of medical safety.
gaps.how to test: Analyze full-screen recordings of overlapping effects at worst viewing conditions; record test method/version and results. Test reduced-flash variants and seek specialist review when risk remains.

gaps.what remains unknown: No universal maximum count or screen percentage establishes readability across effects.
gaps.how to test: Stress the intended busiest scene; vary transparent footprint, overlap and importance distribution; measure target identification, hazard avoidance and frame-time percentiles.

gaps.what remains unknown: No device-independent particle, light, layer, texture-residency or frame-time budget is established.
gaps.how to test: Profile representative low-end devices and actual graphics settings. Capture worst overlaps and long sessions; derive project budgets from measured bottlenecks.

gaps.what remains unknown: The cited juice studies are not direct validation for simulator monetization loops or a common-to-legendary reveal ladder.
gaps.how to test: Compare clear restrained feedback with alternatives using comprehension, enjoyment and repeated-session measures. Do not infer player welfare or long-term retention from a short experiment.

gaps.what remains unknown: No validated variant count, randomization range, cooldown, combo step size or reset duration transfers universally.
gaps.how to test: Use repeated exposure with semantic invariants held fixed. Track recognition, fatigue, perceived consistency and task interference; test aggregation and attenuation as separate interventions.

gaps.what remains unknown: Psychophysical detection windows are task- and stimulus-dependent, not a plug-in latency budget.
gaps.how to test: Measure actual display/audio onset together on target devices; assess detection and impact under realistic input/network timing. Compare offsets without altering sound identity or visual intensity.

gaps.what remains unknown: Simple emotion labels for circles, triangles or hues are not universal causal laws.
gaps.how to test: Test the project vocabulary with unfamiliar players and accessibility modes; distinguish learned convention from direct recognition and cultural association.

gaps.what remains unknown: Upload size does not guarantee runtime resident size or effective visible resolution for every asset path.
gaps.how to test: Inspect actual particle appearance and available memory measurements on target devices; compare cell sizes and projected size, including compression, edges and mip behavior.

gaps.what remains unknown: Film on-twos/on-sixes practice does not establish a Roblox implementation or gameplay benefit.
gaps.how to test: Compare duplicated atlas frames, external sequence control and smooth playback for the same asset; measure tracking and silhouette readability. Preserve authoritative gameplay timing.

gaps.what remains unknown: Some requested candidate titles lack publicly read, maker-attributed breakdowns. Abstracts, portfolios and fan footage cannot substitute for detailed production evidence.
gaps.how to test: Prioritize direct creator interviews/talk recordings for anime, Roblox exemplars and underrepresented juicy games. Add only claims actually documented in accessible material.

gaps.what remains unknown: Available short-term or correlational results cannot establish thousands-of-plays comfort, accessibility, retention or spending effects.
gaps.how to test: Run longitudinal, consented tests with stable gameplay and participant-controlled effects; predefine outcomes and report attrition rather than selecting favorable metrics.

gaps.what remains unknown: Laboratory attention and crowding findings do not directly prescribe a game’s luminance or saturation ratios.
gaps.how to test: Use realistic scenes with competing tasks, alternative palettes and multiple camera distances; measure detection and false positives, then document the project-specific range.

gaps.what remains unknown: Roblox: two official worked examples found, but no sufficient first-hand detailed production breakdowns for Blox Fruits, DOORS or Pet Simulator 99. Fan guesses and asset recreations were not promoted to studio evidence.
gaps.how to test: Seek a maker-attributed breakdown, inspect the full source and verify the claimed method before use.

gaps.what remains unknown: Stylized games: Hi-Fi RUSH and Balatro have useful maker testimony; Hades evidence here establishes intention more than emitter construction. Sparkball and Riot cases are covered by Outputs 1 and 3. Other famous games were excluded without usable documentation.
gaps.how to test: Seek a maker-attributed breakdown, inspect the full source and verify the claimed method before use.

gaps.what remains unknown: Anime: three named-maker cases exist, but two are individual animator interviews rather than studio technical publications. No controlled evidence for a universally optimal impact-frame count or brightness was found.
gaps.how to test: Seek a maker-attributed breakdown, inspect the full source and verify the claimed method before use.

gaps.what remains unknown: Rocksteady 2024 and Beyond-FX 2026 are abstract-only; their contents must not be represented as fully watched/read lectures.
gaps.how to test: Seek a maker-attributed breakdown, inspect the full source and verify the claimed method before use.

gaps.what remains unknown: Rainbow Six 2016 is explicitly historical. Siege X 2025 description provides modern design context but no verification that old replication/collision details persist.
gaps.how to test: Seek a maker-attributed breakdown, inspect the full source and verify the claimed method before use.

gaps.what remains unknown: LEGO Fortnite official Chaos talk exists, but only its description was inspected; it is a lead, not detailed evidence. Do not assert its fracture solver or toy-brick VFX recipe.
gaps.how to test: Seek a maker-attributed breakdown, inspect the full source and verify the claimed method before use.

gaps.what remains unknown: Teardown reverse-engineering blogs were excluded from first-hand implementation claims; developer design sources are stronger for player consequence than for exact modern renderer internals.
gaps.how to test: Seek a maker-attributed breakdown, inspect the full source and verify the claimed method before use.

gaps.what remains unknown: No inspected field source validates universal light/medium/heavy VFX timings, dust lifetimes, debris counts, luminosity ratios, camera-shake amplitudes or flash frequencies.
gaps.how to test: Seek a maker-attributed breakdown, inspect the full source and verify the claimed method before use.

gaps.what remains unknown: Film techniques were executed with controlled cameras and offline resources. A Roblox kitbash reproduces selected visual cues only, unless separate gameplay/simulation systems provide the physical consequence.
gaps.how to test: Seek a maker-attributed breakdown, inspect the full source and verify the claimed method before use.

gaps.what remains unknown: Correct talk metadata: Controlled Chaos: 12 Principles of Design for VFX is Rachel Quitevis / Beyond-FX, GDC 2026. Hanno Hinkelbein / Rocksteady, GDC 2024 is Attention Overload: Creating Readable VFX.
gaps.how to test: Seek a maker-attributed breakdown, inspect the full source and verify the claimed method before use.

intro: Missing numerical evidence is a result, not permission to fabricate a default. These targeted tests would convert uncertainty into project-specific design data.
